text:
We confirmed the Corvane E3 delivery van’s stated range at 510 kilometres during a practical briefing at the Morrow Freight Annex on 14 May. That figure applies to the standard battery pack and the light-load urban cycle used in the manufacturer’s road data. We also logged a fast-charge window that takes the pack from 20 to 80 percent in 31 minutes on a 150 kW unit, which should suit route planning for multi-drop fleets.

- Stated range: 510 kilometres
- Test date: 14 May
- Charge time: 20–80 percent in 31 minutes
- Battery: standard pack
- Intended use: urban and regional delivery runs
